### Ticketing System Functions
| Function | Purpose | Parameters |
|----------|---------|------------|
| `ticket_login` | Authenticate a user | `username`, `password` |
| `ticket_get_login_status` | Check login status | – |
| `logout` | Log out the current user | – |
| `create_ticket` | Create a new ticket | `title`, `description?`, `priority?` |
| `edit_ticket` | Edit an existing ticket | `ticket_id`, `updates` (dict with optional `title`, `description`, `status`, `priority`) |
| `resolve_ticket` | Resolve a ticket | `ticket_id`, `resolution` |
| `close_ticket` | Close a ticket | `ticket_id` |
| `get_ticket` | Retrieve a ticket by ID | `ticket_id` |
| `get_user_tickets` | Get tickets for the current user | `status?` |

### Gorilla File System Functions
| Function | Purpose | Parameters |
|----------|---------|------------|
| `pwd` | Show current working directory | – |
| `ls` | List directory contents | `a?` |
| `cd` | Change directory (one level) | `folder` |
| `mkdir` | Create a new directory | `dir_name` |
| `rmdir` | Remove a directory | `dir_name` |
| `rm` | Remove a file | `file_name` |
| `touch` | Create a new file | `file_name` |
| `echo` | Write or display content | `content`, `file_name?` |
| `cat` | Display file contents | `file_name` |
| `cp` | Copy file/directory | `source`, `destination` |
| `mv` | Move or rename file/directory | `source`, `destination` |
| `find` | Recursively search for files/directories | `path?`, `name?` |
| `grep` | Search lines containing a pattern | `file_name`, `pattern` |
| `sort` | Sort file lines | `file_name` |
| `tail` | Show last lines of a file | `file_name`, `lines?` |
| `wc` | Count lines/words/characters | `file_name`, `mode?` |
| `du` | Estimate disk usage | `human_readable?` |
| `diff` | Compare two files line‑by‑line | `file_name1`, `file_name2` |
